category_edits.rationale: Test whether reducing residual updates from 0.5 to 0.35 preserves useful input information across the six causal blocks. Apply consistently across all four category models and synchronize metadata and predictor checks; keep all other modeling and training choices fixed.

change_summary: Reduce NextItNet residual scaling to 0.35 across all four category models, with matching checkpoint metadata and embedded predictor validation.
